name: Scorch Plasma Grenade
description:
Manufacturer: Kastak Arms
Item Type: Grenade
 
Area of Effect: 7.5 m
Damage Type: Plasma
 
Kastak Arms Scorch plasma grenade is sure to be a devastating addition to your next battle. Once primed and ready, the Scorch will explode on impact, unleashing a burst of intense plasma damage on your target that leave a lingering hazard area behind.
